"""Example using the sanctioned top-level public interface."""
from structurizr import StructurizrClient, StructurizrClientSettings


def upload(workspace):
    """Upload a workspace through the top-level exports."""
    settings = StructurizrClientSettings()
    client = StructurizrClient(settings=settings)
    return client.put_workspace(workspace)
